pins.name: SIG
pins.notes: IRF520 only half-opens at 3.3 V: fine for LEDs, weak for motors. A logic-level MOSFET is better

gotchas.text: On a 3.3 V board the IRF520 only half turns on: its gate threshold is 2 to 4 V and its on-resistance is specified at 10 V. It gets hot and weak with pumps, motors and heaters. Use a logic-level MOSFET module such as the AOD4184, or a relay.

source.title: Vishay IRF520 datasheet
source.section: VGS(th) 2.0 to 4.0 V; RDS(on) specified at VGS = 10 V

sources.section: Gate threshold 2 to 4 V: not fully on at 3.3 V
